Messages.Author: Peter Laan
Messages.Body:
What happens when Tariq with one skill card gets banished? The skill card
doesn't matter when influencing him, but is he a 7 or 3 cap? And what
happens when you bring him up? Does he keep 3 or 4 blood on him?

Peter

Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
"Peter Laan" <peter...@yahoo.com> wrote in message
news:bOsO7.502$l93.1...@newsb.telia.net...

> What happens when Tariq with one skill card gets banished? The skill card
> doesn't matter when influencing him, but is he a 7 or 3 cap? And what
> happens when you bring him up? Does he keep 3 or 4 blood on him?

He is a 7 cap and when you bring him out you get to keep 3 or 4 blood on
him, your choice. It's because all excess blood drains off as he is put in
play, but when he is put in play the skillcard is activated. The order of
it's activation (before draning or after) is up to you (I think that's how
it works, at least it does with embraces etc).

Roger
